body.name: Partition-compatible singleton covered reversal
body.construction: For \(i\to j\) in \(G_{E_0}\), \(\operatorname{rev}_{i\to j}(E_0)\) is defined exactly when \(\operatorname{pa}_{G_{E_0}}(j)=\operatorname{pa}_{G_{E_0}}(i)\cup\{i\}\), \(\{i\}\in\Pi^{E_0}_j\), and \(\Pi^{E_0}_j\setminus\{\{i\}\}=\Pi^{E_0}_i\). It reverses \(i\to j\), sets \(\Pi'_j=\Pi^{E_0}_i\) and \(\Pi'_i=\Pi^{E_0}_i\cup\{\{j\}\}\), and leaves every other partition unchanged.
